candidate: parent publication completion plus retry delay minimum
priorRuns: Earlier publication-consolidation runs excluded from these aggregates: host load was not independently qualified.

method.order: Alternating baseline/candidate; no concurrent tests or benchmarks
method.noiseRule: Fixed-work CPU probes immediately before and after each crawl, outside timed work. Warm probe 5 times; calibrate with 9 samples. Reject both members of a pair if any probe exceeds 1.5 times calibration median, set before measurement. No outcome-based filtering.

freshProcessCheck.note: Each process contributes one median per case; reject the entire round if any variant has fewer than two qualified samples. Earlier tiny-run comparisons remain separate.
